source_behavior.summary: Authenticated AI Usage & Cost observability for the current account/session identity, with persisted AI call/token/cost telemetry, refresh, site filtering, and truthful loading/error/empty states.
source_behavior.identity_rule: The authenticated session is authoritative; a caller-supplied UserId is not trusted.
source_behavior.read_semantics: read-only observability; no server/domain mutation is owned by this canonical route

laravel_adaptation.runtime_data: persisted AiUsageRecord rows and aggregate summary/provider/workflow telemetry; no demo/sample rows
laravel_adaptation.resource_envelope: data/total are derived from the same authoritative recent/summary report so the existing React resource workspace renders real rows while retaining the complete usage report payload

runtime_path: auth + tenant.context activate the requested tenant membership
CanonicalWorkspaceRouteController enforces tenant.view and ai.viewUsage before returning the real React application
React capability resolution becomes enabled only when ai.viewUsage and the real API contract are both present
React requests the tenant-qualified API and renders persisted usage rows, truthful empty state, loading/error state, and refresh
AiUsageReadController re-authorizes ai.viewUsage, derives user_id from the authenticated session, validates optional site, and delegates to AiUsageService
AiUsageRecord BelongsToTenant scope and tenant-scoped Site lookup enforce the active tenant before data is returned

tenant_and_identity_isolation.tenant_scope: AiUsageRecord and Site are resolved under the active TenantContext through BelongsToTenant/global tenant scoping
tenant_and_identity_isolation.same_tenant_other_user: excluded by server-injected authenticated user_id filter
tenant_and_identity_isolation.idor_result: cross-tenant site IDs and cross-user usage rows are not returned

runtime_semantics.authoritative_reread: every refresh performs the same authenticated tenant/user-scoped persisted read
runtime_semantics.idempotency: GET-only; repeated reads do not mutate state
runtime_semantics.retry_safety: frontend query retry/refresh repeats a read-only authorized request
runtime_semantics.audit_or_mutation_receipt: not applicable because this canonical operation is read-only

frontend_vitest: canonical AI usage route binding keeps the exact source workspace contract
canonical AI usage route binding is enabled only when permission and the real API contract are both present
production_like_repository_gates: Pint + SQLite migrate:fresh + full PHP suite
Redis tenant lock + real queue worker + scheduler smoke
production Docker Compose model/image build + stack boot + real runtime smokes + cleanup
